# visualization.design_map.plot_baseline_model { #fmrimod.visualization.design_map.plot_baseline_model }

```python
plot_baseline_model(model, term_name=None, title=None, figsize=None, **kwargs)
```

Plot baseline model terms over time.

Shows drift, block, and nuisance terms as line plots,
with faceting by block/run when applicable.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type          | Description                                                              | Default    |
|-----------|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| model     | BaselineModel | Baseline model to visualize                                              | _required_ |
| term_name | str           | Specific term to plot ('drift', 'block', 'nuisance'). If None, plot all. | `None`     |
| title     | str           | Custom title                                                             | `None`     |
| figsize   | tuple         | Figure size                                                              | `None`     |
| **kwargs  | object        | Additional arguments passed to plot functions                            | `{}`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                          | Description       |
|--------|-------------------------------|-------------------|
| fig    | matplotlib.figure.Figure      | The figure object |
| axes   | array of matplotlib.axes.Axes | The axes objects  |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Plot all baseline terms
>>> fig, axes = plot_baseline_model(baseline_model)
>>>
>>> # Plot only drift term
>>> fig, axes = plot_baseline_model(baseline_model, term_name='drift')
```
